correction: Any prior text saying 705 provides support to a 27-Feb SA surface departure is void because that surface sortie was cancelled by the SA decision re-audit.

decision_logic.motive: Central-Pacific reinforcement pressure is stronger after Eniwetok secure and Truk neutralized; a long-range bomber transfer to the Palau/Peleliu defense system has higher marginal value than retaining the full unit for an unsupported commerce raid.
decision_logic.slack: The transfer is feasible by staged self-deployment, but ground organization and maintenance do not teleport; arrival aircraft are not instantly full-strength sorties.

movement.note: Reorganization and ground-support lag keep immediate eastern sortie generation below departure readiness.

03Mar_center_reconciliation.center_check: 26+13=39 physical; 20+9=29 serviceable; 15+6=21 mission-ready at allocation point. Ferry fatigue then lowers immediate eastern ready count without destroying aircraft.

replacement_guard: Do not credit the historical replacement 24 B5N local structure or the 4-Mar 706th attack-unit reorganization before 4 Mar; that belongs to the next clock window.
331st_NAG: Retains bounded western fighter-defense role through 3 Mar; historical 4-Mar organizational change is future.
Tokai_MAD: Western detachment remains active for convoy/departure-lane ASW. No confirmed datum creates a kill in this window.
operational_effect: By 1-3 Mar the Japanese western system loses most of its flexible long-range bomber search/strike depth. This further lowers the expected value of a surface commerce raid and reduces probability of independently finding SLEUTH.
